prompt_cache_root_cause.observed: With prompt-cache-size=1, later 1.7B outputs repeated fragments from earlier requests.
prompt_cache_root_cause.hypothesis_test: Restarted the same model and worker with prompt-cache-size=0.
prompt_cache_root_cause.result: Five sequential probes returned only ALPHA, BRAVO, CHARLIE, DELTA and ECHO; no prior-request content appeared.
prompt_cache_root_cause.disposition: All fleet launch commands must set prompt-cache-size=0 until MLX cache isolation is independently fixed and tested.
